name: Axiom Systems DermaShock DS-4 'Nettle'
description:
Adhesive patches applied directly to the skin that deliver a 30,000-volt contact discharge when touched by another person's bare skin. The DS-4 uses the body's natural bioelectric field as a circuit component — the wearer's skin provides the ground path, and the patch's outer surface is the active electrode. When another person's skin contacts the patch, their body completes the circuit, receiving the full discharge. The patches are flesh-toned and nearly invisible when applied, designed to be placed on commonly grabbed areas: forearms, upper arms, shoulders, and the back of the neck.

Axiom developed the DS-4 as the most discreet anti-grab defense available. Unlike electrified clothing or visible deterrents, the patches are undetectable until triggered. Each patch contains a micro-capacitor that provides a single discharge, after which the patch is spent. They adhere for up to twelve hours before the medical-grade adhesive degrades, and they are waterproof and sweat-resistant.

The DS-4 is sold in sheets of ten patches for Φ35. Their disposable nature and low cost have made them popular across all tiers, from Tier 1 residents who apply them before walking through dangerous areas to Tier 4 professionals who wear them to business meetings where unwanted physical contact is a concern. Axiom's marketing is deliberately vague about use cases, allowing customers to project their own needs onto the product.
specifications:
voltage: 30,000V
amperage: 1.8 milliamps
discharge trigger: skin-to-skin contact through patch
uses: single discharge per patch
patch dimensions: 4 cm x 4 cm
thickness: 0.3 mm
adhesion duration: up to 12 hours
weight: 2 g per patch
cost: Φ35 per sheet of 10
water resistance: waterproof
tactical_use: Apply patches to areas most likely to be grabbed: forearms (for wrist-grab defense), shoulders (for rear-grab defense), and the back of the neck (for headlock defense). Space patches to cover the most probable contact points. The single-discharge nature means each patch defends against one grab. Apply multiple patches for multi-contact protection. The patches trigger on bare skin contact only — they will not discharge through thick gloves, though thin fabric may allow partial discharge.
cultural_context: The DS-4 has introduced the concept of the body itself as a defended surface. In Tier 1-2 communities, applying patches before going out has become as routine as checking the weather. The patches have also found an unexpected market in nightlife districts, where they are used to deter unwanted touching in crowded venues — a Φ3.50 patch that shocks someone who grabs you without consent has resonated powerfully with communities tired of physical boundary violations.
story_hooks: Medical facilities have reported patients arriving with DS-4 patches still active — healthcare workers have been shocked while examining patients, creating a new workplace hazard in emergency medicine.

A nightclub in Tier 3 has started selling DS-4 patches at the door alongside drink tickets — the club's assault incidents dropped dramatically, but the patches have also been used offensively by patrons shocking people they simply dislike.

physical_description.visual_profile: Nearly invisible flesh-toned adhesive patches, square-cut with slightly rounded corners. At first glance, they appear as translucent medical bandages or cosmetic patches applied directly to skin. The surface has a subtle iridescent shimmer visible only at certain angles—a telltale sign of the conductive layer beneath. When fresh, they're completely flush with the skin; when spent, the adhesive begins to show visible degradation at the edges.
physical_description.dimensions: 4 cm × 4 cm per patch, 0.3 mm thickness. Sold in sheets of 10 patches arranged in a 2×5 grid on a transparent backing card measuring 12 cm × 8 cm.
physical_description.weight_description: Negligible—each patch weighs only 2 grams, making them imperceptible once applied. The sheet packaging is feather-light, designed for pocket or bag carry without any tactile burden.
physical_description.primary_material: Medical-grade conductive polymer adhesive with embedded micro-capacitor layer. Outer surface is a biocompatible elastomer with ionic conductivity. Backing is transparent thermoplastic.
physical_description.finish: Matte flesh-tone with a barely-perceptible metallic sheen from the conductive mesh. The backing is clear with a slight frosted texture to prevent patches from sticking to each other. Edges are cleanly cut with minimal excess adhesive.
physical_description.color_scheme: Primary: naturalistic skin tone (adjustable for regional demographics—tan, light, deep variants available). Accent: silver-grey micro-circuitry visible as fine lines beneath the surface, visible only under close inspection or at oblique angles.
physical_description.grip_texture: When peeled from backing, the patch surface is smooth and slightly tacky—medical adhesive feel. The backing card has a matte finish for easy handling. Once applied, the patch becomes seamlessly integrated with skin, indistinguishable by touch.
distinctive_features: Micro-capacitor housing visible as a barely-raised circular node (3mm diameter) at the patch center
Fine conductive pathways etched into the surface, appearing as hairline traceries under magnification
Iridescent sheen that shifts subtly when skin flexes—a giveaway to trained observers
Degradation pattern: adhesive edges begin to curl and amber-tint after 8+ hours of wear
Spent patches show visible discharge burn marks: faint char lines radiating from the capacitor node
Packaging displays Axiom Systems logo and minimalist product photography; text emphasizes 'discreet protection' without naming the weapon
physical_description.manufacturer_markings: Axiom Systems logo (geometric A symbol) embossed on the transparent backing card. Individual patch sheets stamped with batch code and expiration date (12 months from manufacture) in microscopic text. No markings on the patches themselves—intentionally unmarked for plausible deniability.
physical_description.condition_typical: Fresh patches: pristine, fully adhesive, slight tackiness when removed from backing. Field-worn: partial degradation at edges, slight skin oils and dust accumulation, cosmetic blending with surrounding skin. Spent patches: charred center with radiating burn marks, adhesive failure, visible evidence of discharge.
